resumen: Lying on your back with knees bent, the hips rise until knees, hips and shoulders line up. It is the hip hinge with no load and no technique to learn: the way into the group.
ejecucion: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, about a hand-span from your glutes.
Arms by your sides, resting on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until knee, hip and shoulder are in line.
Do not go higher: anything beyond that comes from arching your back, not from the glutes.
Lower slowly until you brush the floor and start again without resting at the bottom.
matices: In the cited study the barbell glute bridge showed more gluteal activation than the hip thrust, which is the opposite of what is usually said. That is activation within a set, not growth over months, and the hip thrust lets you move a good deal more weight.

fuentes.titulo: Electromyographic differences of the gluteus maximus, gluteus medius, biceps femoris, and vastus lateralis between the barbell hip thrust and barbell glute bridge
